title: Sparkly tent
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='38' ry='6' fill='#5B7A3A'/>
  <!-- tent shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='30' ry='4' fill='#3E5A28'/>
  <!-- tent back pole peak -->
  <polygon points='50,18 22,84 78,84' fill='#E86A3A'/>
  <!-- tent front opening darker -->
  <polygon points='50,18 38,84 62,84' fill='#B84A24'/>
  <!-- tent door triangle -->
  <polygon points='50,30 44,84 56,84' fill='#7A2E14'/>
  <!-- tent left side highlight -->
  <polygon points='50,18 22,84 34,84' fill='#F58A5A'/>
  <!-- tent right side shade -->
  <polygon points='50,18 78,84 66,84' fill='#C2532A'/>
  <!-- tent peak topper -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='16' r='4' fill='#FFD34D'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='16' r='2' fill='#FFF0A0'/>
  <!-- tent door flap left -->
  <polygon points='50,30 44,84 48,84' fill='#9A3A1A'/>
  <!-- tent door flap right -->
  <polygon points='50,30 56,84 52,84' fill='#6A2210'/>
  <!-- door glow -->
  <polygon points='50,34 47,80 53,80' fill='#FFB85C'/>
  <!-- tent guy lines -->
  <line x1='22' y1='84' x2='14' y2='90' stroke='#F5A87A' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='78' y1='84' x2='86' y2='90' stroke='#F5A87A' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- tent side seam highlight left -->
  <line x1='50' y1='18' x2='28' y2='84' stroke='#F79C6E' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <!-- sparkle 1 -->
  <g transform='translate(18,30)'>
    <polygon points='0,-7 2,-2 7,0 2,2 0,7 -2,2 -7,0 -2,-2' fill='#FFF59A'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 2 -->
  <g transform='translate(82,26)'>
    <polygon points='0,-6 1.8,-1.8 6,0 1.8,1.8 0,6 -1.8,1.8 -6,0 -1.8,-1.8' fill='#FFE45C'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 3 -->
  <g transform='translate(76,58)'>
    <polygon points='0,-5 1.5,-1.5 5,0 1.5,1.5 0,5 -1.5,1.5 -5,0 -1.5,-1.5' fill='#FFF59A'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 4 -->
  <g transform='translate(22,62)'>
    <polygon points='0,-5 1.5,-1.5 5,0 1.5,1.5 0,5 -1.5,1.5 -5,0 -1.5,-1.5' fill='#FFE45C'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 5 small -->
  <g transform='translate(68,14)'>
    <polygon points='0,-4 1.2,-1.2 4,0 1.2,1.2 0,4 -1.2,1.2 -4,0 -1.2,-1.2' fill='#FFFBD0'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 6 small -->
  <g transform='translate(32,16)'>
    <polygon points='0,-4 1.2,-1.2 4,0 1.2,1.2 0,4 -1.2,1.2 -4,0 -1.2,-1.2' fill='#FFFBD0'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 7 tiny -->
  <g transform='translate(88,44)'>
    <polygon points='0,-3 1,-1 3,0 1,1 0,3 -1,1 -3,0 -1,-1' fill='#FFF59A'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 8 tiny -->
  <g transform='translate(12,48)'>
    <polygon points='0,-3 1,-1 3,0 1,1 0,3 -1,1 -3,0 -1,-1' fill='#FFF59A'/>
  </g>
</svg>
